Use this page to prepare a SCGSim source checkout for documentation and package
contributions. Install [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/)
and Git first; the [installation tutorial](course/installation.qmd) covers a
study project's Python environment and native solver prerequisites.

```bash
git clone --branch develop https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/scgsim.git
cd scgsim
uv sync --group dev
```

The `dev` group installs every optional extra together with the test, quality
and OpenCASCADE tools: the same set the CI test job uses.

Read the [code map](code-map.qmd) for the stages of the package and which
folder is which, [architecture and data flow](architecture.qmd) for module ownership,
the [maintainer guide](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/scgsim/blob/develop/MAINTAINING.md)
for repository and documentation maintenance, and the
[documentation map](documentation-map.qmd) to find each page's role.
